squat.label: Incomplete Squat Depth
squat.advice: Reach the required bottom position before returning to standing.

squat.label: Excessive Squat Depth
squat.advice: Rise slightly to stay within the required bottom position.

squat.label: Uneven Leg Movement
squat.advice: Keep both knees bending evenly throughout the movement.

squat.label: Bottom Hold Too Short
squat.advice: Hold the valid bottom position for at least one second before rising.

squat.label: Incomplete Squat
squat.advice: Return to standing to complete the movement.
aliases: Squat was not completed by returning to standing

squat.label: Form Needs Attention
squat.advice: Use the real-time form cues to keep the movement controlled.

push-up.label: Incomplete Push-up Depth
push-up.advice: Reach the required bottom position before pushing back up.

push-up.label: Body Alignment
push-up.advice: Keep your shoulders, hips, and ankles aligned throughout the movement.

push-up.label: Uneven Arm Movement
push-up.advice: Bend and straighten both arms evenly.

push-up.label: Incomplete Arm Extension
push-up.advice: Return to the fully raised starting position to complete the repetition.

plank.label: Hips Too Low
plank.advice: Raise your hips slightly to restore body alignment.
aliases: Hips or lower back too low

plank.label: Hips Too High
plank.advice: Lower your hips slightly to restore body alignment.

lunge.label: Shallow or Unstable Lunge
lunge.advice: Reach a stable valid bottom position before returning to the start.
aliases: Lunge depth was too shallow or unstable

lunge.label: Excessive Lunge Depth
lunge.advice: Reduce your depth to stay in the valid bottom range.

lunge.label: Incomplete Lunge
lunge.advice: Return to the starting position to complete the repetition.
aliases: Lunge was not completed by returning to the start position

lunge.label: Camera Orientation Changed
lunge.advice: Maintain a side view so your movement stays visible.
aliases: Camera orientation became unsuitable during the Lunge

lunge.label: Body Moved Out of View
lunge.advice: Keep the required body landmarks visible throughout the movement.
aliases: Required landmarks were lost during the Lunge

leg-raise.label: Raised Position Not Reached
leg-raise.advice: Reach a stable valid raised position with straight legs.
aliases: Leg Raise did not reach a stable 30°–60° hip-flexion position

leg-raise.label: Bent Knees
leg-raise.advice: Keep your knees extended throughout the raise and lowering.
aliases: Knees bent during the Leg Raise

leg-raise.label: Legs Raised Too High
leg-raise.advice: Keep the raised position within the required target range.
aliases: Legs were raised above the 60° target range

leg-raise.label: Raised Hold Too Short
leg-raise.advice: Hold the valid raised position for at least one second before lowering.

leg-raise.label: Incomplete Leg Raise
leg-raise.advice: Lower back to the starting position to complete the repetition.
aliases: Leg Raise was not completed by returning to the lowered position

leg-raise.label: Camera Orientation Changed
leg-raise.advice: Maintain a side view so your movement stays visible.
aliases: Camera orientation became unsuitable during the Leg Raise

leg-raise.label: Body Moved Out of View
leg-raise.advice: Keep the required body landmarks visible throughout the movement.
aliases: Required landmarks were lost during the Leg Raise
